prompt:
Handheld camera, tight and moving with them, drifting a little towards whoever leans in. Bob jabs his finger at Tarquin three times in a rhythm, stepping half a pace forward on the last jab; his jaw works as he shouts. Tarquin gives ground, one half-step back, his raised hands opening palms out, then he plants his feet and stops retreating. Rain keeps falling and drips off the end of Bob's pointing hand; firelight flickers across both of them. Sound: rain, the fire, a shoe scuffing wet tarmac, breathing. No spoken words.
Thanks.
